subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about registered, returning fans for {Brand}. With the 2026 World Cup on home soil drawing 27.5 million US viewers for the opener, fan-intent demand is spiking now, and sports is already the priciest US Apple Ads category at a $26.81 median CPI, with cost per registration commonly 2.5x to 3x that. That is the window where optimizing to the registered, returning user decides your real cost. We hold out a control group so the paid registrations read as incremental lift. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: 2026 World Cup US demand spike (sourced) + sports CPI/CPR benchmark band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN sports_media_and_community: acknowledges second follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely 2026 World Cup US viewership spike (NBC Sports, web-verified 27.5M opener) + market benchmark band (sports $26.81 median CPI from AppTweak; CPR ~2.5-3x CPI); both URLs retrieved and support the numbers; no MobUpps figure this stage; holdout/incrementality referenced without a figure; reuses only parent brands; 1 question mark; native en; no sign-off; no em-dash; X-not-Y avoided.
